frank: quick flag 1: invoice-preview for a few customers flickered to 0 around 02:46 UTC. console showed a dip then recovered within ~90s. seems tied to a patch that changed sku->route bindings.

yasmin: can you drop a trace id or sample event? my radar says routing metadata churn + quota-heartbeat TTL race.

frank: sample tenant `atlas-commerce`, trace `t-8f2e`. ingest excerpt:
```
2025-03-11T02:45:58Z INFO route-resolver bind sku=stable-us -> route:r33
2025-03-11T02:46:00Z WARN quota-heartbeat ttl_expired tenant=atlas-commerce window=45s
2025-03-11T02:46:01Z INFO metering-emitted tokens=312 route=r33 fingerprint=fp-55c session=s-71
```

drew: our preview dedupe currently uses key `tenant|fingerprint|route_resolution_id`. when the route_resolution_id flips mid-session the preview aggregation can mis-order and show transient zeroes. billing finalization (post-rollup) remains consistent.

sophie: product insists on per-SKU preview breakdown. we can't remove route id from dedupe globally without losing that visibility.

yasmin: thought: introduce a preview-only session-canonical mapping at ingest. when tenant+session+fingerprint observe a route flip within short window (TTL=75s), map later events to the canonical_preview_route (first observed route in session). preview dedupe uses canonical_preview_route; billing path remains strict and unchanged.

frank: so preview will present costs under the canonical route for short-lived flips, avoiding zeros, but invoices still reflect exact route ids. good separation of concerns.

drew: implementation sketch: maintain ephemeral map keyed by `tenant|session|fingerprint` -> `{canonical_route, expires_at}`. on ingest: if key exists and observed_route != canonical_route and now < expires_at then mark event as `preview_canonical=canonical_route` else set canonical to observed_route. preview aggregator resolves dedupe using `preview_canonical` when present. pseudo:
```
mapKey = tenant+"|"+session+"|"+fingerprint
if map[mapKey] and map[mapKey].expires > now and map[mapKey].canonical != observed_route:
    emit.preview_route = map[mapKey].canonical
else:
    map[mapKey] = {canonical: observed_route, expires: now + TTL}
    emit.preview_route = observed_route
key = tenant + "|" + fingerprint + "|" + emit.preview_route
```

yasmin: risks: if we canonicalize too long we might hide actual duplicates that should be deduped by route-level logic (retries). mitigations: only canonicalize when session_id present AND fingerprint unchanged AND within TTL. also mark preview events with `preview_canonical=true` for audit.

pm-aaron: product copy request: add a small tooltip in invoice-preview: "Preview groups short-lived route changes to reduce noise; final invoices use exact route ids." also put a subtle banner during canary.

ingest-bot: NOTICE: 1742109999 - partition-9 consumer-lag spike 02:45-02:48 max=15s

sre-bot: alert suppressed for deploy window; runbook: routing-rebinds-in-deploy (ref #77).

drew: telemetry: we'll emit `preview_canonical_emitted` log events and a metric `preview_canonical_count` with tenant tag. recommend a per-tenant gauge in the preview panel and an aggregated alert if >0.5% of events are canonicalized for >10m.

frank: rollout plan: behind feature-flag `preview_session_canonical`. canary 2% tenants for 2h. watch `invoice_preview_gap_pct`, `preview_canonical_count`, and final billing diff.

yasmin: qa: unit tests for map TTL behavior, integration test simulating rA->rB flips in same session, and ensure no cross-tenant collisions. include a chaos test with delayed heartbeats.

drew: i'll open the PR with tests and a small console change. will tag @eng-platform when canary is ready.

pm-aaron: product will prepare the tooltip and a short blurb for customers in EAP.

sophie: follow-up ticket: audit other dedupe compositions that include volatile routing metadata (region, placement_id, sku_tags) and evaluate whether preview-only canonicalization should apply more broadly.

frank: thanks all. if we can get a canary before morning support hours that should cut down incoming tickets. :thumbsup:
